summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Canadian waste-management company GFL Environmental Inc., reporting Q1 2026 financial results and raising full-year guidance. The filing mentions a proposed acquisition of SECURE Waste expected to close in H2 2026, but provides no definitive agreement, price, terms, or board recommendation; it is merely a forward-looking reference in an earnings press release. The primary event is a routine quarterly earnings update with guidance raise. No special-situation trigger such as a signed merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. Therefore, this is not a special-situation filing.
